text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the Arima Kinen amidst 
roaring cheers, Tokai Teio felt in a 
dreamlike daze, unable to fully grasp the 
reality of it.

Symboli Rudolf praised her opponent, but 
vowed that she would reclaim the throne 
that had been taken from her.

Hearing her words, the reality of finally 
defeating the "Emperor" began to sink in.

And with Symboli Rudolf urging her on, she 
dashed out before the massive crowd to 
proclaim the birth of the new "Emperor."
